$comment: Contract-shape ratchet (scripts/ci/check_contract_shape.py, ADR-0081). Numbers may only fall; raising one requires --write-baseline --reason, recorded in growth_reasons.

growth_reasons.production_lines: the UTC calendar codec moved from awaken-session-contract into the clock port's own crate so every context spells a clock reading identically

growth_reasons.catch_all_errors: merged awaken-environment-realization-contract; its 2 instances moved here, workspace total unchanged

growth_reasons.production_lines: single-source the realization-lease laws: SandboxEffectFence::for_operation and fence_is_live_at join the fence kernel in provisioning (+23); session-contract lease/generation rules now call that kernel instead of repeating the field comparison (+12 at three call sites, -6 projection)
growth_reasons.catch_all_errors: Classify/Disposition vocabulary moved down into agent-contract so sandbox failures classify without a provisioning->runtime edge; provisioning-contract gains the typed SandboxError classes and the neutral handle-evidence codec that replaced its backend payload enums (backend nouns 10->0); SandboxError Transport/Invalid are classified failure classes carrying detail, replacing the former untyped SandboxError(String)

growth_reasons.production_lines: extract Session identity, Budget, Dream, Event, MCP, and Work owners behind the existing facade; replace unsupported capability defaults with required or exact role ports; type Resource error detail while preserving category variants

split Dispatch value-model and aggregate roles into cohesive modules to satisfy the source-file hard limit without moving or weakening tests; claim-scoped recipient delivery adds one response-local field so an exact claim can receive a fresh envelope without persisting transport material

runtime-contract retains the cancellation and attached-channel capability supertraits plus the advisor de-duplication kernel; claim-scoped recipient delivery adds the minimum neutral Runtime types and validation kernel so expired publication envelopes can be reissued without another contract dependency layer
session.rs split into session/{roles,neutral}.rs for the 2000-line file limit; +6 lines are the mod/use declarations of the split
